Please treat this as urgent and seek in-person emergency care right now rather than continuing to search online."}

That said, I'd get it checked by a doctor or urgent care if: you can't bear weight at all, there's significant bruising, the pain is worsening rather than improving after 48 hours, or there's visible deformity. An X-ray can rule out a fracture, which isn't always obvious from swelling alone. When in doubt, getting it looked at is the safer call."}
